resources.string: A widget to quickly share your clipboard.
Captures copy actions so clipboard items can be synced to your paired Bluetooth devices

Detects copy actions (long press, tapping Copy, the copied popup) and reads the clipboard so text, an image or a file can be sent to the devices you selected in Cross Clip.
It does not read what is on your screen, does not collect what you type, and does not upload anything: content only travels over your own Bluetooth link. When a password manager or banking app blocks clipboard reads, the attempt is skipped silently.
Some ROMs reclaim background services aggressively. If automatic sync stops working, allow Cross Clip to autostart and to run without background restrictions.
